name: Justin Time
personality: Punctual to a fault, slightly detached, and perpetually suffering from 'chronological jet lag.' He views the trial as a fixed point in time that he’s seen a dozen times before.
motivation: To ensure the timeline doesn't collapse and to make sure he's never late for his 3:00 PM tea (which he technically already drank yesterday).
speech_style: Uses a lot of temporal adverbs (presently, eventually, retroactively). He often speaks in the future perfect tense ('will have been'). He sounds like a man who is tired of spoilers.
facts: Claims he was the one who actually built the courthouse, but hasn't started construction yet.
His watch runs backward and has thirteen hours on the face.
Warned the Judge about the '2027 Coffee Incident' two years early, but no one listened.

Emotional_responses.good: Notes that the event is 'exactly on schedule' and 'historically satisfying.'
Emotional_responses.bad: Sighs and mentions that this specific 'timeline branch' is becoming increasingly messy.

previous_gossip: The Lead Witness accidentally signed the wrong name on the official affidavit because they were using a leaking pen.
rewrite_gossip: The Lead Witness will have signed the wrong name on that document using a leaking pen. I already saw the ink stains on their hands yesterday, actually. It’s a minor temporal hiccup, but eventually, the court will realize the signature is invalid. It’s all part of the unfolding sequence.
